---
title: "check-def-title-synonyms.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, warn-only check that flags the title of a definition div
that lists synonyms with parentheses or "also called".
The lab's rule (Ezra, 2026-10-23) is that the title is a comma list
with the primary term first, as in "Logistic function, sigmoid, expit".
This implements
[psw#338](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/psw/issues/338).

A title is the first heading line inside a `#def-` div, or its `title=` attribute.
The check reports a title on a line the pull request adds
when it holds a parenthesis, "also called", "also known as",
"a.k.a.", "aka" or "or simply".
Math (`$...$`) and a parenthetical that contains math are ignored,
so "Almost everywhere ($\measure$-a.e.)" passes.

An untouched title is never reflagged.
With no base ref the check skips instead of scanning the whole tree;
`whole-tree` measures a corpus.

## Usage

Copy [`examples/check-def-title-synonyms.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-def-title-synonyms.yml)
to `.github/workflows/` in your repository.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check |
| `fail` | `false` | Fail the workflow on a finding instead of warning |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Scan every title, not only a pull request's additions |
| `runs-on` | `ubuntu-latest` | Runner label; self-hosted only for a private repository |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version to set up |
